## 🚀 Feature Description
A clear and concise description of the feature or architectural enhancement you would like.

## 🤔 Motivation / Use Case
Why is this feature needed? How does it improve the Clean Architecture or Domain-Driven Design of the framework?

## 💡 Proposed Solution
Describe the solution you'd like. E.g., Adding a new `BaseValidator` class.

## 🔄 Alternatives Considered
A description of any alternative solutions you've considered.
